g1-implement.title: g1 shared work_id helper module: implement
g1-implement.imperative: Fill templates/IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF.template.md and dispatch constellation-implementer via scripts/run_crew.py. TASK: create C:/Programs/constellation-skills/scripts/work_id_paths.py -- the single shared statement of the work_id contract -- plus C:/Programs/constellation-skills/tests/test_work_id_paths.py. NOTHING imports the module in this gate (that is deliberate: an unimported new file cannot break any install, so this gate boundary is trivially green -- critic F3). API, exactly two public functions: (1) work_id_from_session_name(session: str) -> str, the EXACT inverse of run_crew.session_name()'s 'constellation/<work_id>/<gate>/<role>/attempt-<n>' grammar: validate parts[0] == 'constellation', len(parts) >= 5, and no empty segment, then return '/'.join(parts[1:-3]); do NOT hard-require the literal 'attempt-' prefix (critic F1) and raise a ValueError naming the expected grammar on refusal (the run_crew caller translates it to CrewLaunchError, so no new exception type crosses that seam). (2) archive_dirs_for_work_id(archive_root: Path, work_id: str) -> list[Path], the segment-aware recognizer: normalize separators (a Windows-authored 'epic-659\\665' reads identically to 'epic-659/665'), let k = number of work_id segments, enumerate archive_root directories at depth EXACTLY k, and accept a candidate when its archive-relative POSIX path equals work_id or ends with '-' + work_id -- and apply the same two tests to the flattened form (segments joined with '-') so BOTH the nested '<date>-epic-659/665' and the flattened '<date>-epic-659-665' shapes are recognized (decision:archive-matcher-is-a-recognizer-not-a-namer). Return ALL matches, never 'the first' (critic F2). The module docstring is the contract: state plainly that a work_id MAY contain '/' path segments, that this is the nested Commander-under-Admiral convention, and that resolving to the WRONG work area is worse than refusing. TESTS (unittest.TestCase, collected by pytest, NO skips -- CI runs scripts/verify_skip_guard.py, critic F6): round-trip work_id_from_session_name(session_name(w,g,r,n)) == w for a single-segment id AND for 'epic-659/665'; the real field string 'constellation/epic-659/665/g1-implement/implementer/attempt-1' -> 'epic-659/665'; refusal on a bad prefix, on too few segments, and on an empty segment; archive recognition for nested, flattened, and plain single-segment dated names; non-recognition when the depth is wrong; the known leaf-collision case pinned as documented behavior (critic F2); a missing archive_root returning [].
